name: Haleakalā National Park
policyReason: Dogs are allowed only in parking lots, on roads and paved paths.
summary: Dogs are allowed only in parking lots, on roads and paved paths.

excerpts.quote: Pets are allowed on a leash no longer than 6 feet within the campground and on the roads within campground boundaries.
Dogs are not permitted on trails.

dogRules.text: Not on trails or at Hosmer Grove Campground.
Do not bring dogs into buildings.
